name: isitlegit-media
description: IsItLegit channel videos in Remotion. Its own pnpm root (media/pnpm-workspace.yaml), outside the root workspace.

scripts.studio: pnpm run stats && pnpm run voice && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render:01: pnpm run stats && pnpm run check:facts && pnpm run voice && remotion render src/index.ts DevProcess out/raw/01-how-isitlegit-is-built.mp4 && remotion ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/raw/01-how-isitlegit-is-built.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/01-how-isitlegit-is-built.mp4
scripts.render:02: pnpm run stats && pnpm run check:facts && pnpm run voice && remotion render src/index.ts TechDeepDive out/raw/02-isitlegit-technical-deep-dive.mp4 && remotion ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/raw/02-isitlegit-technical-deep-dive.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/02-isitlegit-technical-deep-dive.mp4
scripts.render:03: pnpm run stats && pnpm run check:facts && pnpm run voice && remotion render src/index.ts LoupeV1 out/raw/03-loupe-1-0.mp4 && remotion ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/raw/03-loupe-1-0.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/03-loupe-1-0.mp4
scripts.render:logo: pnpm run stats && pnpm run voice && remotion render src/index.ts LogoReveal out/isitlegit-logo-animation-1080p.mp4
